smells.finding: _trip_advisory grew by ~19 lines (two new locals + a second conditional append at each of the two existing HARD sub-branch returns) but its control-flow shape is unchanged -- same branches, same nesting depth. Not materially longer in a way that hurts readability; the added block is a self-contained compute-then-append pattern mirroring the existing live-note pattern line for line.
No classes touched by this diff; checklist_engine.py is a module of functions.

begin_over_line_records_historical's loop body (isinstance/outcome-filter/append) is a near-total textual clone of begin_over_line_records, differing only by the why_ref keying line and the _latest_why_record lookup that feeds it. A shared filter-and-collect helper returning the unkeyed candidate list, with the live selector adding its own why_ref filter on top, would remove the duplication without touching either selector's observable behavior. Non-blocking: (a) this is a quality/simplification opportunity, not a correctness defect -- my own mutation testing (d5/d6/d12) proves both selectors behave correctly and independently as shipped; (b) the Admiral explicitly ruled this rework's fix space narrow (B1 only) and directed against expanding it; (c) the two loops' textual independence is arguably intentional defense-in-depth, matching the code's own stated rationale that the historical selector is 'a second, unkeyed view... not a second write and not a second source of truth' -- collapsing them into one parameterized helper would reintroduce a single point where a future edit could silently affect both signals at once, which is exactly the failure shape N22 exists to guard against. Recorded as a triage candidate for a later, separately-scoped consolidation, not a blocker on this narrow fix.
Both new/changed functions operate only on their own cl argument and module-level helpers (_latest_why_record); no reaching into another module's internals.
trip_ledger entries carry the same field set (gate/verb/outcome/fill/hard/model/why_ref/ts) they already carried pre-rework; no new parameter group is introduced or passed around together.
The outcome values 'begin-refused'/'begin-released' are plain string literals, duplicated across the write site and both read selectors (4 occurrences total).
